<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex3052023-11-241" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
       <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (84a7–84b1)"/>don gyi gnas rnams ni phal cher <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">slob dpon bdag nyid chen po</rs>s <note type="editorial">Probably rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (db:3786)</note> sbyar ba | 'di nyid kyi don bsdus ba dang | 'grel ba rung ba'i bshad sbyar gyi rjes su 'brangs te rtogs par bya'o || 
       'dir ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3806">kho bo</rs>s skyes bu dam pa de'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i zer ma la gces spras byas te <pb n="84b"/><lb n="84b1"/> tshig gi cha ji tsam rnyed pa de brjed byang du bkod pa yin no ||
       <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4464">'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa</rs>'i don cung zad | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3806">dge slong blo gros 'byung gnas</rs> kyi brjed byang du bkod pa yin no || ||</seg></TEI>
